title: Book of Revelation: people who cannot die

tellings.quote: befalling on earth you have a group of people who cannot die

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest who says he has hunted for giants, reads the Book of Revelation as describing a time when calamities fall on the earth and "you have a group of people who cannot die." He draws on the King James Version of the Bible, published in 1611, and gives no other source. He offers it as a picture of the end times that fits what he describes elsewhere.
